instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Regional electricity distribution system operator managing 8,000 km of medium and low-voltage lines serving 350,000 customers. The company relies heavily on traditional SCADA systems for monitoring but is increasingly constrained by the need to manage intermittent renewable energy sources without compromising grid reliability.
answers.pastInitiatives: Our digital transformation program is in its third year with a dedicated transformation office reporting to the CEO. We have completed an ERP migration to the cloud, rolled out a company-wide data warehouse with self-service BI dashboards, and established a center of excellence for process automation using RPA and low-code tools. The program has delivered €2.4M in annualized cost savings to date.
answers.strategicGoals: Our primary objective is to reduce operating expenses by 15% over the next 2 years while maintaining current output levels. We believe there is significant waste in our manual processes and want to identify the highest-ROI automation opportunities across order processing, invoicing, and customer support workflows. We are not looking to grow headcount—we want to do more with our existing team.
answers.additionalContext: New data localization requirements in our second-largest market will force us to re-architect our cloud infrastructure within 12 months to maintain operating licenses. This is a non-discretionary technical project that will consume significant engineering capacity. Innovation initiatives must be sequenced around this mandatory work or find ways to turn the migration itself into a modernization opportunity.
answers.teamSize: We have a small technology team of 4-6 people including developers, a part-time DevOps engineer, and a product manager who also handles project management. The team is fully allocated to maintaining current products and handling integration requests from key clients. Innovation work is done in the margins—there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.

opportunities.title: RPA Implementation for Invoice Processing Automation
opportunities.rationale: By using existing low-code tools to automate the high-volume manual task of invoicing and order processing, Helix can achieve immediate operational efficiency gains without requiring major capital expenditure or disruptive process changes. This directly supports the strategic goal of reducing operating expenses.

first_actions: Identify three highest volume/lowest value manual tasks in the finance department.
Pilot an RPA bot on a single, repeatable invoicing workflow.
Secure approval for necessary software licensing within Q2.
execution_plan.success_metric: 30% reduction in time spent on invoice processing within 6 months.
milestones: Q2: Pilot completion and ROI validation.
Q3: Roll out to the entire accounts payable team.

opportunities.title: Predictive Maintenance Modeling for Substation Assets
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging the existing data warehouse and smart meter telemetry, Helix can develop a radical predictive model to forecast equipment failure in critical transmission assets. This shifts maintenance from reactive schedules to condition-based interventions, potentially reducing unplanned downtime significantly.

first_actions: Establish a cross-functional data science task force (Engineering + IT).
Define the scope for modeling one critical substation type.
Allocate dedicated time from the product manager to oversee model development.
resources_needed: External consultant specializing in energy SCADA data analytics
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 15% reduction in unplanned asset downtime within the first year.
milestones: Q3: Data pipeline integration and feature engineering complete.
Q4: Model validation and operational deployment trial.

next_steps.action: Conduct a detailed process mapping workshop focused solely on identifying high-waste manual tasks in customer support and order fulfillment.
Initiate a small, proof-of-concept RPA pilot for the highest volume administrative task to validate efficiency ROI.

key_weaknesses: Lack of formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget prevents proactive exploration outside mandatory technical projects.
Small team size and full allocation to core maintenance tasks create high capacity constraints for strategic innovation work.
Integration between legacy SCADA systems and modern data analytics tools remains complex, hindering the realization of radical predictive opportunities.
Culture resistant to shifting from reactive operational mindset to proactive, data-driven efficiency initiatives.
